name: sm-scriptlibrary-reviewer
description: Read-only static and explicitly consented AI review for OpenText/HPE Service Manager ScriptLibrary source.

commands.title: SM Reviewer: AI Review Current File
SM Reviewer: Set AI API Key
SM Reviewer: Clear AI API Key

smReviewer.enableOnSave.description: Review supported ScriptLibrary documents when they are saved.

smReviewer.enableDiagnostics.description: Show SM Reviewer diagnostics in the editor.

smReviewer.ai.enabled.description: Allow explicitly invoked AI review. Source transmission still requires confirmation for every review.

smReviewer.ai.model.description: Model identifier sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

smReviewer.ai.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. Remote endpoints must use HTTPS.

smReviewer.ai.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for an explicitly invoked AI request.
